verdict.rationale: dlt doesn't expose a classic OpenAPI spec of its own API (probe explicitly found openapi.json/swagger.json 404s), but it does publish machine-readable equivalents for AI agents: a verified llms.txt (confirmed HTTP 200), an MCP server-card.json describing tool capabilities, and an agent-skills index.json. This satisfies the 'or equivalent' clause of the story but not a literal OpenAPI download. Missing for 10: an actual OpenAPI/Swagger spec for dlt's own API surface, and probe confirmation that the MCP/agent-skills JSON endpoints are live (only llms.txt was directly verified).
